summary: Basic family vocabulary is fine, but idioms and relationship phrases were translated word for word into wrong or meaningless Italian (non vediamo sempre gli occhi, siamo cresciuti for 'grew apart', elevato a valorizzare, vai bene con, sei vicino ai tuoi fratelli, la mia più vecchia amica). Also several apostrophe-for-accent misspellings, a dropped 'eightieth', the usual cloze items without blanks, and roleplay/dialogue items lacking answerEnglish or a situation.
